title: Renew Actor Original Work Funds
description: Every browser plugin actor draws all turns, commands and jobs from one finite original stock issued once at activation; when an axis runs out the guest refuses everything. Design and implement a renewal that keeps the receipt and identity laws: a kernel-issued, receipted successor operation admitted when the actor is quiescent (TypeScript and Rust twins, component bridge source, guest reactor context), decide live versus cumulative capacity accounting, and a typed original-stock-exhausted fault. Schema and language-agnostic fixtures first, native and TypeScript tests, no weakened laws, no compatibility layers.
